physics_in_package.notes: surfaceBrightnessRatio, chromaticity, rgbUnitLuminance (blackbody.ail), deaberrate, dopplerApparent (optics.ail) all exist in sunholo/relativity 0.3.0, which sim/ailang.toml pins; the new GDScript Relativity.surface_brightness_ratio mirrors the package fn. The fitter calls the package chromaticity directly. sRGB<->XYZ matrix constants (IEC 61966-2-1) in sky_model.ail, main.gd _xy and the Y weights in SkyModel/shader are a colour-space standard rather than relativity physics; acceptable, though the fitter's duplicate in AILANG and the golden's duplicate in GDScript could be taken from one package export (RGB<->XYZ helper) later. Tint carry is photographic colour bookkeeping, not new physics.
